verdict.rationale: Omarchy's docs say it ships OpenCode and Claude Code as the default agent harnesses. It provides terminal aliases for them: `c` starts OpenCode in the current directory and `cx` starts Claude Code in danger mode. The docs also mention pre-wired launchers for every major coding-agent CLI, first-boot agent setup, and bundled agent skills, which together deliver in-terminal AI coding agents out of the box. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the agents writing and running code in practice.
